overview_description.description: Commercial Bank Of Qatar engages in conventional banking, brokerage services, and credit card businesses in Qatar and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, Alternatifbank A.S., and Other Subsidiaries. It offers personal banking products and services, including current, savings, time deposit, and call accounts; credit and debit cards; personal, vehicle, and mortgage loans; life, home, vehicle, and travel insurance; and private banking services that include wealth management, investment products, and brokerage services.

product.name: Retail Banking Accounts
product.description: Bank accounts for individuals to manage deposits, payments, transfers, and everyday financial activity.

product.name: Commercial Bank Cards
product.description: Credit and payment cards for purchases, cash access, and account-based transactions, including Mastercard and Visa products.

product.name: Deposits
product.description: Deposit products that allow customers to hold funds with the bank and manage savings or other balances.

product.name: Personal Loans
product.description: Personal financing options that provide individuals with funds for personal financial needs and flexible repayment arrangements.

product.name: Vehicle Loans
product.description: Vehicle financing for customers purchasing cars, with repayment terms determined by the selected loan and borrower eligibility.

product.name: Mortgage Loans
product.description: Property financing solutions for customers seeking to purchase residential or other eligible property in Qatar.
